template.template: Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS
template.name: Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS
template.description: Dashen Bank GRG ATM hardware monitoring via 32-bit CEN/XFS 3.0 API. Collects Cash Dispenser (CDM) status and cash inventory plus Card Reader, Printer, PIN Pad and SIU sensor status through isolated XFS calls.

item.name: GRG XFS — full status & cassette inventory
item.description: Raw single-line JSON payload from C:\monitor\grg-xfs-probe.ps1 -Json querying XFS msxfs.dll

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.status.device;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.status.safe_door;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.status.dispenser;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.status.intermediate_stacker;

item.name: CDM Summary — Total Dispensable Cash
item.description: Total currency value in all active dispense cassettes

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.summary.total_amount;

item.name: CDM Summary — Total Notes
item.description: Total banknote count across all dispense cassettes

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.summary.total_notes;

item.name: CDM Summary — Reject Notes Count
item.description: Current rejected note count in reject bin

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.summary.reject_count;

item.name: CDM Summary — Retract Notes Count
item.description: Current retracted note count in retract bin

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.summary.retract_count;

item.name: CDM Summary — Has Low Cassette
item.description: 1 if any active dispense cassette is below its minimum threshold, else 0

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.summary.has_low;

item.name: CDM Summary — Has Empty Cassette
item.description: 1 if any active dispense cassette count is 0, else 0

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.summary.has_empty;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["Rej01"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["Rej01"].count : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["Rej01"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["Rej01"].status : 5;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["Rct01"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["Rct01"].count : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["Rct01"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["Rct01"].status : 5;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0050A"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0050A"].count : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0050A"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0050A"].status : 5;

item.name: Cassette 0050A — Dispense Cassette 3 (ETB 50) Reject Count
item.description: Reject count associated with Dispense Cassette 3 (ETB 50)

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0050A"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0050A"].reject_count : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0100A"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0100A"].count : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0100A"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0100A"].status : 5;

item.name: Cassette 0100A — Dispense Cassette 4 (ETB 100) Reject Count
item.description: Reject count associated with Dispense Cassette 4 (ETB 100)

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0100A"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0100A"].reject_count : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0100B"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0100B"].count : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0100B"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0100B"].status : 5;

item.name: Cassette 0100B — Dispense Cassette 5 (ETB 100) Reject Count
item.description: Reject count associated with Dispense Cassette 5 (ETB 100)

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0100B"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0100B"].reject_count : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0200A"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0200A"].count : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0200A"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0200A"].status : 5;

item.name: Cassette 0200A — Dispense Cassette 6 (ETB 200) Reject Count
item.description: Reject count associated with Dispense Cassette 6 (ETB 200)

step.params: var j = JSON.parse(value); return j.cdm.cassettes["0200A"] ? j.cdm.cassettes["0200A"].reject_count : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.idc && j.idc.device !== undefined) ? j.idc.device : 255;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.idc && j.idc.media !== undefined) ? j.idc.media : 255;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.idc && j.idc.retain_bin !== undefined) ? j.idc.retain_bin : 255;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.idc && j.idc.cards !== undefined) ? j.idc.cards : 0;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.ptr && j.ptr.device !== undefined) ? j.ptr.device : 255;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.ptr && j.ptr.paper !== undefined) ? j.ptr.paper : 255;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.pin && j.pin.device !== undefined) ? j.pin.device : 255;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.siu && j.siu.cabinet_door !== undefined) ? j.siu.cabinet_door : 255;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.siu && j.siu.safe_door !== undefined) ? j.siu.safe_door : 255;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.siu && j.siu.supervisor_switch !== undefined) ? j.siu.supervisor_switch : 255;
var j = JSON.parse(value); return (j.siu && j.siu.tamper_sensor !== undefined) ? j.siu.tamper_sensor : 255;

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.device_status)<>0 and last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.device_status)<>6 and last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.device_status)<>255
trigger.name: CDM — Cash Dispenser Hardware Fault on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: The cash dispenser hardware is reporting an error or offline state (Busy is excluded).

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.safe_door)=2
trigger.name: CDM — Safe Door Open on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: The ATM safe / vault door is currently open.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.dispenser)=2
trigger.name: CDM — Dispenser Stopped on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: The cash dispenser mechanism is halted / in stop state.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.total_amount)=0
trigger.name: CDM — Out of Cash on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: All cash cassettes are empty; ATM cannot dispense cash.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.total_amount)<50000 and last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.total_amount)>0
trigger.name: CDM — Total Cash Low (< 50,000 ETB) on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: Dispensable cash on the ATM is below 50,000 ETB threshold. Replenishment recommended.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.reject_count)>=250
trigger.name: CDM — Reject Cassette Nearly Full on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: Reject cassette Rej01 has 250 or more rejected bills (max capacity ~300).

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.cassette.count[0050A])=0
trigger.name: CDM — Cassette 0050A (50 ETB) Empty on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: Dispense Cassette 3 (ETB 50) note count has reached 0.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.cassette.count[0100A])=0
trigger.name: CDM — Cassette 0100A (100 ETB) Empty on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: Dispense Cassette 4 (ETB 100) note count has reached 0.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.cassette.count[0100B])=0
trigger.name: CDM — Cassette 0100B (100 ETB) Empty on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: Dispense Cassette 5 (ETB 100) note count has reached 0.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.cdm.cassette.count[0200A])=0
trigger.name: CDM — Cassette 0200A (200 ETB) Empty on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: Dispense Cassette 6 (ETB 200) note count has reached 0.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.idc.device_status)<>0 and last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.idc.device_status)<>6 and last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.idc.device_status)<>255
trigger.name: Card Reader — Hardware Error on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: The card reader hardware is reporting a failure (Busy is excluded).

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.idc.media_status)=3
trigger.name: Card Reader — Card Jammed on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: A customer card is jammed inside the card reader.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.ptr.device_status)<>0 and last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.ptr.device_status)<>6 and last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.ptr.device_status)<>255
trigger.name: Printer — Hardware Error on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: The XFS printer is reporting an offline or hardware error state (Busy is excluded).

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.ptr.paper_status)=2
trigger.name: Printer — Paper Out on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: Printer is out of paper. Receipts cannot be printed.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.ptr.paper_status)=1
trigger.name: Printer — Paper Low on {HOST.NAME}

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.pin.device_status)<>0 and last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.pin.device_status)<>6 and last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.pin.device_status)<>255
trigger.name: PIN Pad — Hardware Error on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: PIN Pad / EPP module is reporting a failure (Busy is excluded).

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.siu.cabinet_door)=2
trigger.name: SIU — Cabinet / Fascia Door Open on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: The upper cabinet / fascia service door is open.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.siu.supervisor_mode)=1
trigger.name: SIU — Supervisor / Maintenance Mode on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: ATM has been switched into Supervisor / Maintenance mode.

trigger.expression: last(/Dashen Bank ATM Hardware - GRG XFS/atm.xfs.siu.tamper)=1
trigger.name: SIU — Tamper Alarm on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: Security tamper sensor triggered on the ATM!
